dedupe_keys.name: base de donnees routieres bdroute nc au format geodatabase

description: Base de données routières (BDROUTE-NC) au format Géodatabase is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Dans un souci de qualité, de caractérisation et de suivi des infrastructures routières et pour répondre à de fortes attentes liées à la navigabilité, le bureau de la cartographie a souhaité améliorer la couche « voirie » de la BDTOPO-NC. Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Territory Development, Infrastructure, Territory, Transport, Mobility. Its keywords are routes, transports, voies, reseaux, reseau, navigabilitescessibilitesroute. The portal shows 2026-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
